theme: An open day in St. Pete, with an early start waiting tomorrow.
greeting: Nothing on the calendar held you today, Dan — a rare clear stretch at the Coffee Pot cottage. Tomorrow opens early, though, with back-to-back calls from 7:30.

acts.line: No meetings on the books — the St. Pete morning was yours to shape.
The open stretch ran clean through the afternoon, nothing scheduled to break it.
Tomorrow starts early with calls from 7:30, so tonight tilts toward an early wind-down.
